hypothesis: Causal action selection triggered only by at least two distinct physical contradictions that independently favor a retained alternative context improves cold-return unseen-pair competence and decreases wrong-confident predictions relative to continuous disagreement maximization, passive actions, trigger-sham and independently coded conventional contradiction-triggered interventions.
physics: Use exactly SL06 seed-specific 4-bit physical state/four-effect-action physics: each A/B/C regime samples a unique 40-rule grammar rule per action via Random(seed*131+phase*719+action*47), collision increment, ABA etc. Regimes switch at paid steps 20/40/60; ABCA return A, ABCB return B, STABLE remains A, ABCD_OOD fourth D is int(state==15) xor (seed+action)&1. The world generator, seed, hidden regime and evaluator 64-pair labels cannot be read by learners. No simulation trials or reset of physical state.
budget: Each of 32 worlds × seven independent arms executes exactly 80 paid physical steps, 10 charged exogenous flips at [6,14,22,30,38,46,54,62,70,78] bit (seed//7+step//8)%4, leaving 70 genuine causal action consequences. All arms receive same first 60 paid physical events with action step%4 at every nonflip; cold serialize and verify/restore at 60 before they choose their own paid actions. Post-60 environment branches may differ by chosen action; equal 80 paid steps does NOT establish equal information obtained or computation. Total 17920 paid steps, 15680 causal observations; shared pre-cold trace SHA256/arm.
selection_rule: For each real pre-update charged causal event, compare active-bank current-state unanimity against actual observed physical effect; a useful contradiction requires the active bank unanimously predict the *opposite effect* and at least one distinct retained bank unanimously predicts the observed effect, and the two memories' predictions are mutually exclusive on that witnessed state/action. Do not treat ambiguous outcomes, exogenous flips, hidden phase, evaluators or dreams as contradictions. Keep a bounded <=12 paid-causal-event rolling witness window of distinct (state,action) discriminants, require >=2 distinct witness pairs before arming a four-paid-causal-observation intervention window. Reset window after firing; do not infer which bank/phase is correct or change frozen memory update. While armed, choose the action maximizing between-bank mutually exclusive unanimous physical-effect predictions (n0*n1) with tie-break secondary within-bank rule disagreement z*o, final tie smallest action; otherwise choose fixed step%4. Four paid causal events count down only on real causal events. No extra actions are permitted. Witnesses are computed BEFORE the original learner updates its masks.

negative_controls: A passive and always-on arm isolate conditional intervention value. Trigger sham controls activity from ordinary observation surprises. Native no-gate tests prediction safety. Independent conventional witness/always policy uses HMM posterior, not native rule counts. Frozen models and world physics unchanged; trigger is a wrapper, not learning from evaluation outcomes. Report distinct witness events, armings, intervention actions, confident abstentions, costs/bytes, checkpoint behavior, unseen-pair coverage, prequential charged-action predictions. Complete 64-pair audit queries on 8 worlds/cohort -> 512 per cohort; score correct, wrong_confident, abstained and never-physically-observed state/action queries. Track prequential scores separately; never compare on-policy returns as if same difficulty after trajectories diverge. All seed/rule/phase audit truth is evaluator-private; no feedback to learner or action policy. Cold serialise/restore original learner and wrapper state at step 60; identical pre/post predictions & trigger policy, tamper rejection.
